sections.title: Arizona property tax: state rules

rows.label: Levied by
rows.value: Counties, cities, towns, community college districts and school districts (plus special districts)
rows.note: Each governing body fixes primary and secondary property tax levies and rates by the third Monday in August.

source.title: Arizona Revised Statutes 42-17151: County, municipal, community college and school tax levy

rows.label: State oversight
rows.value: Arizona Department of Revenue (general supervision of county assessors)
rows.note: ADOR's own property tax page (azdor.gov) blocked automated access; statute cited instead.

source.title: Arizona Revised Statutes 42-13002: Relationship between department and county assessors

rows.label: Residential property tax cap
rows.note: Constitutional cap on ad valorem taxes collected from residential property: 1% of full cash value (as limited by Section 18).

rows.label: Annual cap on taxable value increase
rows.note: Since tax year 2015 the value used for all ad valorem taxes is the lesser of full cash value or 5% above the prior year's limited value.

sections.title: Arizona real estate transfer tax

rows.label: Real estate transfer tax
rows.value: None: the Arizona Constitution bars new real property sale or transfer taxes
rows.note: Applies to the state, counties, cities and districts; fees or taxes already in existence on December 31, 2007 are not affected.
